extract_fields.AgriculturalProduceType: the value printed next to 'Nama Pertanian :' / 'Agricultural Produce Type' heading (e.g. 'Anggur Hijau')
extract_fields.CountryOfOrigin: the full value(s) printed next to 'Negara Asal :' / 'Country Of Origin' heading, including both the English and Malay text
extract_fields.ExporterBlock: the full value printed next to 'Nama & Alamat Pengeksport:' / 'Exporter by Name & Address:' heading, including the GLN number
extract_fields.AgentCode: the value printed next to the standalone 'Agent:' heading
extract_fields.ImporterName: the company name portion only (not the address) of the value printed next to 'Nama & Alamat Pengimport:' / 'Importer Name & Address:' heading
extract_fields.ImporterAddress: the address portion only (excluding the company name) of the value printed next to 'Nama & Alamat Pengimport:' / 'Importer Name & Address:' heading
extract_fields.GGN: the 13-digit value printed next to 'GGN:' in the pack details row (near PUC/PHC/Orchard)
extract_fields.OriginField: the value printed next to the standalone English-only 'Origin' heading in the bottom pack details row (near PUC/GGN/PHC/Orchard) -- NOT the 'Negara Asal / Country Of Origin' bilingual field near the top of the label
